o1: Enables receptor tyrosine kinase binding activity; enables Wnt-activated receptor activity. Involved in establishment or maintenance of cell polarity; asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; axis specification; and generation of neurons. Is located in neuron projection membrane and plasma membrane. Is expressed in B cell; P3.p male; P4.p male; epithelial cell; male-specific anatomical entity; and neurons. Is part of the Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with LIN-44.
